# The Last Warrior

The Last Warrior may refer to:
* The Last Warrior (1970 film), an American Western film directed by Carol Reed
* The Last Warrior (1989 film), a British film directed by Martin Wragge
* The Last Warrior (2000 film), an American action film directed by Sheldon Lettich
* The Last Warrior (2017 film), a Russian-American co-production directed by Dmitry Dyachenko
See also
* The Final Executioner (1984), ''L'ultimo guerriero - Italy (original title), also known as The Last Warrior
* The Scythian (2018), Skif - Russia (original title), released as The Last Warrior'' in English-speaking markets
